title: Nashville Oasis - Walk to Broadway - POOL, Parking
description:
3 Bed Condo with FREE parking and a private deck overlooking the Cumberland River. This condo complex has a Pool with updated patio furniture, gym and a laundry facility. Walk to downtown Nashville and all the Broadway bars. Next to Germantown -a hip & popular neighborhood with lots of great restaurants, coffee shops & bars. Also near Brooklyn Bowl, Sounds Baseball Stadium, Ryman, Titans Stadium, Country Music Hall of Fame plus so much more! Fully equipped kitchen plus two TVs with cable!

The space
HIGHLIGHTS: 

★ 3 Beds
★ 1 Bathroom with Shower/Tub combo (you do not need to walk through the bedroom to get to the bathroom)
★ Walk to downtown Nashville & all the Broadway bars
★ Private deck with seating for 2 overlooking the Cumberland river
★ Onsite pool, gym, and laundry facilities
★ Fully equipped kitchen for all of your cooking needs
★ Dining table with seating for 4
★ Air mattress available 
★ Electric fireplace
★ 2 HD flat screen TV with with cable, including one in the bedroom
★ High-speed internet
★ Hair dryer and iron
★ Board games
★ FREE parking right in front of the condo
★ Located on the first floor - no steps to climb!
★ Building fire pit area overlooking the river
★ Hassle-free check-in with no keys, just codes 
★ Located next to Germantown neighborhood - a popular area with great restaurants, coffee shops and shopping
★ Right next to Sound Baseball Stadium & Brooklyn Bowl (see some great music concerts!)
★ Hair dryers, shampoo, conditioner and body wash provided

BEDS: 
Bedroom: 2 Queen Beds
Living room: Sleeper Sofa + Air Mattress

BATHROOM: 
1 Full-Size bathroom with shower / bath combo. The bathroom is off of the hall. You do not need to walk through a bedroom to get to the bathroom.

After a fun day out exploring Nashville, come back to relax in this quiet, spacious, comfy condo. Although parking is free & easy, you don't need a car for this condo. Many things are within walking distance! There is public transportation and it's only 15 mins from the airport. There are plenty of Ubers, Lyft and taxis available. Our condo is in a great location to enjoy all the things that Nashville has to offer.

Walk To (alphabetical order):
- Ascend Amphitheater
- Bicentennial Park
- Bridgestone Arena (Predators)
- Brooklyn Bowl Music Venue
- Country Music Hall of Fame
- Country Music Television (CMT)
- Farmers Market
- Germantown
- Hard Rock
- Honky Tonks
- LP Field (Titans Stadium)
- Music City Center (Convention Center)
- Printer’s Alley
- Restaurants such as Jonathan’s, Merchants, Jeff Ruby’s, Puckett's, Morton's, The Southern Steak & Oyster, Wildhorse Saloon and numerous others!
- Ryman Auditorium
- Schermerhorn Symphony
- Sounds Minor League Baseball Stadium
- Tennessee Performing Arts Center (TPAC)

**Note regarding the pool: Most outdoor pools in Nashville are open May through September, depending on the weather. It is up to our HOA to determine the exact date of when the pool opens & closes throughout the year.

Please note, no smoking is allowed in the condo. 

We allow some pets. All pets must be approved in writing by the owner prior to check in. There is a $75 pet fee that you will be charged after booking.

Guest access
You'll have access to our entire condo plus the complex's gym and laundry facility.

Other things to note
Check in is at 4pm and check out is at 11am.

Early check in times selected through the app are not applicable. If you would like early check in, you must message us.
